title: [Chapitre] V. Algèbre des figures : notes manuscrites (14/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the previous pages of the chapter 'Algèbre des figures'). L is a set and Phi is a family of subsets of L, with |Phi| the union of its members. Phi is 'preadmissible' if every x in |Phi| has a smallest member A(x) of Phi containing it. For A in Phi, the boundary ∂_Phi A is the union of the members B of Phi with B strictly contained in A, and the interior is A° = A minus ∂_Phi A. Phi is 'admissible' if every A° is nonempty. Then the map phi : |Phi| -> Phi, x |-> A(x), has fibres A° = phi^{-1}(A). The A° partition |Phi|; this partition is the equivalence relation R_Phi. Phi, ordered by inclusion (a poset I), carries its Alexandrov topology: open sets are upward closed, closed sets are downward closed. A subset J of I gives A_J = phi^{-1}(J), the union of the A_i° for i in J. Open, closed and locally closed parts of |Phi| correspond to open, closed and locally closed (order-convex) J. When Phi is finite, the A° are the atoms of the Boolean algebra generated by Phi.

This page: sub-families. A sub-family Psi of Phi is called admissible ('sous-famille admissible') if it is closed in Phi, i.e. downward closed: if B is in Phi, B ⊂ A and A is in Psi, then B is in Psi.
- For A in Psi, the members of Phi strictly inside A all lie in Psi. Hence ∂_Psi A = ∂_Phi A and the interiors computed in Psi and in Phi agree.
- Consequently |Psi| = A_Psi = phi^{-1}(Psi), the union of the A° for A in Psi. So |Psi| is R_Phi-saturated (and closed) in |Phi|.
- Preadmissibility of Psi: if x is in |Psi|, pick A in Psi containing x. Then x ∈ A(x) ⊂ A, so A(x) is in Psi by closedness. Thus A(x) is also the smallest member of Psi containing x.
- Admissibility of Psi: its interiors equal those computed in Phi, hence are nonempty.

Proposition (begun here, finished on p.7). For Phi admissible and Psi a family of subsets of L, the following are equivalent:
(a) Psi ⊂ Phi and Psi is closed in Phi; a marginal variant adds that |Psi| is R_Phi-saturated.
(b) Psi ⊂ Phi, Psi is admissible, and R_Psi is the restriction of R_Phi to |Psi|.

On p.7, b ⟹ closed is proved as follows. Take B in Phi with B ⊂ A for some A in Psi. Then B° is nonempty and, being an R_Phi-class inside |Psi|, equals the interior (in Psi) of some C in Psi; this forces B = C.

In modern terms this is the elementary theory of a space stratified by a poset of 'closed cells' (a decomposition indexed by a poset with the Alexandrov topology). Admissible sub-families are the closed sub-stratifications ('subcomplexes'), corresponding bijectively to closed (downward-closed) subsets of the index poset. The material serves Grothendieck's aim of an algebra of 'figures', i.e. constructible combinatorial pieces, probably linked to his tame-topology / 'dévissage' programme.
errors: No genuine error. The step 'B° = C° implies B = C' (p.7) is left implicit, but it is correct. Since Psi ⊂ Phi, the interior of C computed in Phi is contained in the interior computed in Psi, which equals B°. If B were strictly contained in C, then B would lie in ∂_Phi C, so the Phi-interior of C (nonempty, Phi being admissible) would be disjoint from B ⊃ B°, a contradiction.

The added margin condition '|Psi| saturé dans |Phi| pour R_Phi' is weaker than closedness by itself; saturation alone corresponds to Psi being an arbitrary subset of Phi. It is presumably meant as a consequence or extra remark, not as a replacement for 'fermée'.

ideas.what: Admissible family of subsets: a space decomposed into nonempty 'interiors' A° indexed by the inclusion poset, with each x having a smallest containing member
ideas.modern_name: Poset-stratified set / regular cell decomposition with face poset; Alexandrov topology on the face poset
ideas.usually_credited_to: Alexandrov (1937) for finite topologies; standard in combinatorial topology (face posets of regular CW complexes)
ideas.where_published: Unpublished 1986 notes; tame-topology ideas only sketched in Esquisse d'un programme

ideas.what: Admissible sub-families equal closed (downward-closed) subsets of Phi, with boundaries and interiors unchanged and |Psi| saturated and closed in |Phi|
ideas.modern_name: Subcomplex / closed union of strata corresponding to a downset of the face poset

ideas.what: Characterisation of closed sub-families as admissible sub-families whose induced equivalence relation (stratification) is the restriction of the ambient one
ideas.modern_name: Sub-stratification compatible with the ambient stratification

deep.surprise_reason: Correct, elementary bookkeeping on poset-indexed decompositions and their closed sub-families (subcomplexes). It is interesting only as part of the unpublished 'algèbre des figures' programme; no new result or connection on this page.
